fields.v: Benchmark: 50 Terminal-Bench Pro tasks, 1 trial per task per cell, 900 s cap. No success criterion stated by the authors (pass rate and tokens per solved task reported; lower tokens better). (a) Goose + Qwen 3.6 Plus: pass 48.0% [34.0, 62.0], 28,142 tok/solve, 17.96 avg turns, 0.20 no-action turns; failures Sv23/Rs20/Vf0/Tm3/MT1/Hg2/Er1; quality and cost verdicts: no criterion stated by the authors. (b) Goose + MiniMax M2.5: 38.0% [24.0, 52.0], 36,950 tok/solve, 25.25 turns, 0.30 no-action; Sv17/Rs15/Vf0/Tm7/MT8/Hg2/Er1; no criterion stated. (c) OpenCode + Qwen 3.6 Plus: 50.0% [36.0, 64.0], 1,147,740 tok/solve (40.8x Goose), 21.71 turns, 2.16 no-action; Sv25/Rs15/Vf0/Tm5/MT0/Hg4/Er1; no criterion stated. (d) OpenCode + MiniMax M2.5: 46.0% [32.0, 60.0], 1,546,977 tok/solve (41.9x), 27.46 turns, 2.00 no-action; Sv22/Rs16/Vf0/Tm10/MT0/Hg1/Er1; no criterion stated. (e) OpenHands-SDK + Qwen 3.6 Plus: 50.0% [36.0, 64.0], 841,201 tok/solve (29.9x), 25.95 turns, 0.72 no-action; Sv25/Rs3/Vf6/Tm5/MT6/Hg4/Er1; no criterion stated. (f) OpenHands-SDK + MiniMax M2.5: 46.0% [32.0, 60.0], 843,286 tok/solve (22.8x), 24.19 turns, 0.66 no-action; Sv21/Rs1/Vf8/Tm6/MT6/Hg7/Er1; no criterion stated

fields.v: Tasks: stratified random 50 of 200 public Terminal-Bench Pro tasks, drawn before any run, none removed; IDs listed. Configurations: 3 harnesses x 2 models (full factorial). Baseline: none designated (harnesses compared to each other; Goose used as reference for token ratios). Held constant: verbatim task instruction, native pytest suite, Daytona sandbox per task, 900 s wall-time cap, OpenRouter gateway with default sampling, largely identical system prompt and shared four-skill playbook, run via Harbor with identical task manifests. Not equalised (the studied variable): native tool API, context preloading, retry/sub-agent logic; turn cap 40 for Goose and OpenHands-SDK, none for OpenCode. Acceptance tests: native pytest suites. Repetitions: 1 trial per task per cell. Human intervention: none (autonomous); no harness-level retries

fields.v: Pass rate: within-model harness range 2-8 pp; largest gap Goose vs OpenCode on MiniMax -8.0 pp (95% CI [-18.0, 0.0]); Goose vs OpenCode on Qwen -2.0 pp [-12.0, +8.0]; OpenCode vs OpenHands-SDK 0.0 pp on both models; most differences not distinguishable from zero. Cost: Goose << OpenHands-SDK < OpenCode on both models; OpenCode about 40x tokens per solved task vs Goose; bootstrap CIs non-overlapping (Goose [21K, 61K] vs OpenCode [733K, 2.50M]). Goose on the Pareto frontier; OpenCode Pareto-dominated. No-action turns about 10x higher for OpenCode. Failure fingerprints replicate across models (Goose REASON, OpenHands-SDK VERIFY/MAX TURNS, OpenCode TIME/HANG). IMPL category: OpenHands-SDK 69% vs 38%/38%. Model upgrade: 4-10 pp pass rate, 1.0-1.3x tokens

fields.v: Partly: distinguished harnesses clearly on token cost (non-overlapping CIs) and failure profile, but not on pass rate (n = 50, one task = 2 pp, differences within bootstrap noise; treated as descriptive). Repeatability: one trial per cell; configs, raw logs and scripts released; authors warn provider defaults may shift and exact replication needs pinned routes and sampling. Limitations stated: sample size, token-accounting asymmetry (Goose total only), turn-budget asymmetry and harness-defined 'turn', three harnesses and two models only

Recommendations/gaps: leaderboards should use harness-model pairs as the unit and report tokens per solved task, no-action turns and failure-category vectors alongside pass rate, with full harness specifications

fields.v: Reporting inconsistency: Table 4 solved counts (Goose Qwen 23, Goose MiniMax 17, OpenCode MiniMax 22, OpenHands MiniMax 21 of 50) do not match the Table 2 pass rates (48%, 38%, 46%, 46% = 24, 19, 23, 23); only OpenCode Qwen and OpenHands Qwen (25 = 50%) agree; not explained in the text. Table 4 columns MT/Hg/Er garbled by text extraction; rebuilt from row totals (n = 50) and text: Goose Qwen 1/2/1, Goose MiniMax 8/2/1, OpenCode Qwen 0/4/1, OpenCode MiniMax 0/1/1, OpenHands Qwen 6/4/1, OpenHands MiniMax 6/7/1 (consistent with text 'OpenCode 4/1 HANG', 'OpenHands 6/6 MAX TURNS'). Avg turns (Table 3) and no-action turns (Fig. 2) read from extracted figure/table values in row order; Qwen/MiniMax order of no-action values inferred from text (Goose 0.2/0.3). Abstract says '40x' while Table 3 gives 22.8x-41.9x depending on harness and model. OpenHands hit-turn-budget 8/9 exceeds MAX TURNS 6/6 (explained by decision tree). Harness versions not stated. Replication package: anonymized configs, raw Harbor trial logs, aggregated snapshots and analysis scripts at anonymous.4open.science (frozen for review). No pre-registration. Programming language: task-dependent (shell, Python, C and others), not reported as a variable
